events.title: Agent update
events.detail:
`npm run build` succeeded: TypeScript check passed and Vite produced the production bundle. The chunk-size note is only a warning about bundling Three.js into one file.

**What was built.** Canyon Strike is now implemented in `/workspace/src` as a Three.js third-person air-combat mission. TASK.md was left unmodified.

- **World**: procedural mountain canyon with an analytic height function used for both the mesh and collision, vertex-colored rock, snow caps, gradient sky shader with sun, sprite clouds, and distance fog.
- **Flight**: arcade quaternion flight model with pitch, roll, yaw, throttle, coordinated banked turns, gentle self-levelling, dive and climb speed effects, and a smoothed chase camera whose field of view widens with speed.
- **Combat**: cannon with overheat, 36 lock-on homing missiles with a lock cone and timer, flares that spoof incoming missiles, and target cycling.
- **Enemies**: 17 ground sites (SAM launchers, AA guns, radar stations, fuel depots) with aimed turrets, plus 10 enemy fighters across four waves. Fighters pursue, break off, avoid terrain, and fire guns and missiles.
- **Mission flow**: destroy 10 primary targets, then an extraction beacon appears at the canyon exit. Win by reaching it. Lose by being shot down, crashing into terrain, or staying outside the mission area for 8 seconds. Start, win, and lose overlays with stats and a restart button.
- **Feedback**: target boxes and off-screen arrows, lock ring, gun pipper, hit markers, radar, heading tape, PULL UP and MISSILE warnings, damage vignette, camera shake, explosions, smoke trails, bur…
